{{Quote|My son is an engineer at those shipyards. You saved his life|Clento Rone thanking Voidhound|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Clento Rone's son''' was a [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] son of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Clento Rone]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he worked as an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] in the Republic shipyards, which were saved from an Imperial assault by the [[Voidhound]].
